summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by Tuya Inc., a Cayman Islands foreign private issuer, with the SEC. It attaches a monthly return submitted to the Hong Kong Exchange that reports no changes in authorized or issued share capital for June 2026. The filing is a routine administrative report on share movements, not a special situation. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, restructuring, or other special event is disclosed. The document merely satisfies reporting obligations under Rule 13a-16.
